description: This map displays a false-colour satellite image of an inland freshwater area located within the Tablas de Daimiel Natura 2000 site in Central Spain. A green line outlines the "Border of Natura 2000 site". Within this designated area, land cover classifications are indicated based on visual interpretation of the imagery. Areas appearing dark blue/black are identified as "Open water visible in imagery", which corresponds to land cover class "8.2.1 Natural lakes". Areas exhibiting a purplish/reddish tone, indicative of vegetation, are classified as "Reeds > 30%", corresponding to land cover class "7.1.1 Inland marshes". This illustrates specific classification criteria for wetland types within a protected area.
